save_backup.title: Protect a separate save before continuing
save_backup.why: The restart selection changes what survives into the next run.
save_backup.detail: Keep that slot until every linked request, outcome, catalogue row, and carried record has been checked.

point_of_no_return.title: Finish the open ledger before committing
point_of_no_return.why: Replacing the source clear can destroy the only verified outcome state.
point_of_no_return.detail: Clear available exploration records and preserve the earlier slot before this transition.
